Use Conventional Commits: https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/. Keep commit messages short, clear, and specific. Use the format type(scope): description when a scope is useful, otherwise type: description. Prefer standard types such as feat, fix, refactor, chore, docs, test, style, perf, build, ci, and revert. Write the description in imperative, lowercase style without unnecessary details or a trailing period. Mention breaking changes with ! or a BREAKING CHANGE: footer when required.
